Title: Danse Macabre feedback survey - Alpha version

Messages.Author: Migalart
Messages.Body:
This is ALFA Version of the survey
Please provide your comments and ideas regarding the survey.

Danse Macabre feedback survey

By answering this survey you are helping us to create even better extensions in the future….

1 GENERAL QUESTIONS REGARDING EXTENSION.

1.1 Did you tested Danse Macabre cards?
I tested new cards and feel competent to provide general and detailed feedback
I tested new cards and feel competent to provide general feedback
I tested new card but do not feel competent to provide feedback
I didn’t test new cards
Other answer…………..
No answer

1.2 Are you planning to use Danse Macabre cards in near future ?
Yes
No
Other answer…….
No answer

If 1.2 No
What is the reason you are not planning to use Danse Macabre cards in near future
- I don’t have time to play at all
- I don’t like the extension
- I don’t like the extension publishing form (self printing)

If you feel competent to provide general feedback please assess Danse Macabre extension in the areas mentioned below.

1.3 Mechanics level of new cards
Very good
Good
Avarage
Bad
Very Bad
Other answer…………..
No answer

1.4 Artistic level level of new cards
Very good
Good
Avarage
Bad
Very Bad
Other answer…………..
No answer

1.5 Technical level of card publication
Very good
Good
Avarage
Bad
Very Bad
Other answer…………..
No answer

2 DETAIL DANSE MACABRE CARDS ASSESMENT
Please assess the power of anly if you feel competent

For each card the following question:

Very good card
Good card
Average card
Week card
Wallpaper

VEKN Marketing CoDirector

Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
How are Technical and Mechanics different for 1.5 and 1.3?

For question 2, I'd ask in a different way:

Broad Power Card (Must have in every deck)
Specific Power Card (Must have in specific decks)
Broad Useful Card (Will often see play in most of my decks)
Specific Useful Card (Will often see play in specific decks)
Corner Case Card (Will occasionally see play in unusual situations)
I will never play this card.
{And then have a question if they check the last one "Why would you never play this card?}
